file(GLOB_RECURSE MCU_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS cpp/*.cc)
list(FILTER MCU_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "_test\.cc$")
file(GLOB_RECURSE MCU_TEST_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS cpp/*_test.cc)

find_package(absl CONFIG REQUIRED)

add_library(material_color_utilities STATIC ${MCU_SOURCES})
add_library(mcu::mcu ALIAS material_color_utilities)
target_include_directories(material_color_utilities PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_features(material_color_utilities PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(material_color_utilities PUBLIC absl::flat_hash_map absl::strings)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(material_color_utilities PRIVATE /utf-8 /W0)
    target_compile_definitions(material_color_utilities PUBLIC _USE_MATH_DEFINES)
endif()

if(LAMINA_BUILD_TESTS)
    find_package(GTest CONFIG REQUIRED)
    add_executable(mcu_tests ${MCU_TEST_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(mcu_tests PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shim)
    target_link_libraries(mcu_tests PRIVATE material_color_utilities GTest::gtest GTest::gmock GTest::gtest_main)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(mcu_tests PRIVATE /utf-8 /W0)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME mcu_tests COMMAND mcu_tests)
endif()
